notes: League phase ranking per Art. 17.03-17.04 and tiebreakers per Art. 18.01 (a-j). Disciplinary points and club coefficient are not in our data, so a tie that reaches them is broken by a seeded random draw. Knockout structure (Art. 19-22) is implemented in app/simulations/ucl.py; the bracket paths in Annex B are published only as an image and were taken from UEFA's written draw explainers, cross-checked against the 2024/25 draw.
